name: Everflowing Chalice
oracle_text:
Multikicker {2} (You may pay an additional {2} any number of times as you cast this spell.)
This artifact enters with a charge counter on it for each time it was kicked.
{T}: Add {C} for each charge counter on this artifact.
blocked_sentences: Multikicker {2} (You may pay an additional {2} any number of times as you cast this spell.)
This artifact enters with a charge counter on it for each time it was kicked.

needs.what: the multikicker guard must accept a card whose only reader of 'additional_paid' is a 'self_enters_with_counters' replacement -- i.e. loader._mentions should walk model.replacements (their 'amount' and 'condition' value expressions) the way it already walks spell_effects, targets, ability effects, ability targets and trigger conditions. The same walk feeds the mirrored check just below it ('reads additional_paid but has no additional_cost'), so both should be fixed together. Nothing else is missing: with _mentions patched to see replacements, the card {multikicker: "{2}", replacements: [{event: self_enters_with_counters, counter: "charge", amount: {additional_paid: true}}], plus a mana ability {op: add_mana, mana: "{C}", amount: {counters_on: {counter: "charge", objects: {self_only: true}}}}} passes schema, compile, residual and playable, and the sandbox measures 6 charge counters (MAX_ADDITIONAL_TIMES) -- so the fix is one walk, and the answer that follows it asserts counters {kind: "charge", amount: 6}.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The printed 'Multikicker {2}' line has exactly one claimant -- the card-level 'multikicker' field (verify._covered matches it against card.multikicker; fidelity declares it). Spelling it as 'additional_cost' + 'additional_optional' + 'additional_repeatable' loads, but leaves the printed line unclaimed at the residual gate, and gate 5 only casts the card multikicked when card.multikicker is not None, so the kicks would never be paid or measured. But setting 'multikicker' fails compile with "has a 'multikicker' cost that no effect reads via 'additional_paid'", because loader._mentions never descends into model.replacements -- and a replacement is where 614.1c requires 'enters with a charge counter ... for each time it was kicked' to live. The only shape that satisfies the guard is a 'self_enters' triggered ability running add_counters {additional_paid: true}, which loads and would probably pass every gate while being the wrong card: the artifact would be seen on the battlefield at zero counters, the counters would arrive from a separate object on the stack that can be responded to or removed, and they would fire counter_placed watchers that a replacement does not. That is the approximation the brief forbids, so no answer is written.
